doc: What fires the FX, the lights and the camera kicks (core/render/README.md). `sim` cues are read render-side from the sim snapshot (features/city/view/city_fx_feed.gd: a projectile slot appears = shot, disappears = projectile_end, a person turns dead = death), so they need no event and change no sim state. `event` cues follow an F-04 Events signal by name. `vehicles` cues are read off the service cars after each step (features/vehicles/vehicle_cues.gd: hp lost, a wreck, a slide, a ram). fx: fx.json kinds spawned at the cue (the angle is the shot heading; projectile_end throws back, death uses the body heading). shake: a camera.json shake id ("" = none). shake_near_m: only cues within this many metres of the camera focus kick it (0 = always). hitstop: a camera.json hitstop id ("" = none): the game holds still that many ticks (SimClock.hold, none under reduced motion, cooled down by hitstop_cooldown_ticks). A row player_hit_<weapon> (dashes as underscores) fires after player_hit when that weapon hit Rivet.

triggers.doc: a round leaves a gun: the paper star at the mouth and a spent casing
a round stops (a wall, a car, a body or its range): ink chips thrown back
a person dies: an ink splat under the body
Rivet takes a hit (Events.player_hit): sparks off the chassis and the hit shake
Rivet kills someone (Events.actor_killed with killer_id = Rivet's id): the kill hit-stop, no FX of its own (the death cue draws the splat)
Rivet takes a Robo-tazer hit (Events.player_hit with weapon robo-tazer; fired after player_hit): the electroshock crackle over the sparks
a car takes a hard hit (8+ hp in one tick: a ram, a wall at speed; VehicleCues): sparks and debris off the body, the crash shake near the camera
a light knock (under 8 hp; VehicleCues): a spark, no shake (the audio lane's metal hit)
a car is wrecked (VehicleCues): the explosion, smoke and debris, the explosion shake
the driven car starts a slide above 7 m/s (VehicleCues): audio only
traffic the driven car rammed leans on the horn (VehicleCues, at most every 45 ticks): audio only
